req.title: Show index page
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET / with an HTML page listing all posts ordered by created descending.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the index page should list all posts in descending order of creation. The test suite includes a positive test to verify correct functionality, a negative test to handle client errors, and a boundary test to ensure correct ordering of posts.

tests.name: test_show_index_page_positive
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded posts.
actions: Send a GET request to the '/' endpoint.
expected: HTML page with post titles in descending order of creation.
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

r = client.get('/')
assert r.status_code == 200
assert b'Heacon signal pulse' in r.data  # Most recent post
assert b'Pillow delta willow' in r.data  # Oldest post

tests.name: test_show_index_page_negative
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded posts.
actions: Send a GET request to a non-existent endpoint.
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

r = client.get('/nonexistent')
assert r.status_code == 404

tests.name: test_show_index_page_empty_database
preconditions: The database is initialized with no posts.
actions: Send a GET request to the '/' endpoint.
expected: HTML page with no post titles.
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
